panel.title: Measure motion
panel.hint: Click the object in each epoch. The mark snaps to the center of the source.
panel.markCenter: Mark at the center of the view
panel.measuring: Saturated source: measuring with the coverage layer…
panel.needTwo: Mark the object in another epoch to measure how far it moved.
panel.sameDate: The marks share the same date: another epoch is needed.
panel.off: With the object marked in two or more epochs, its motion per year is worked out. Turning it on switches the viewer to blink mode.
panel.markCenterDisabled: The current epoch has no image in this band: there is nothing to mark.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.agrees: Agrees with the catalog within the measurement error.
catalog.differs: Differs from the catalog by more than the measurement error explains.
catalog.mismatch: The marked source is {{offset}} away from where the catalog places {{name}}: it is a different object.
catalog.note: The catalog value comes from the expected positions at the same epochs, computed the same way.

notice.title: Measurement notices
notice.neighbor: There is another source {{distance}} from the mark of {{date}}: closer than 12″ the two overlap and the measured position may be contaminated.
notice.neighborMany: There is another source within 12″ of {{n}} marks (the closest, {{distance}} away): the two overlap and the measured positions may be contaminated.
notice.wings: Saturated source: the center comes from fitting the wings, not the core.
notice.coverage: The coverage layer of a mark is missing: its position is provisional.
notice.season: The marks are from opposite seasons, and two are not enough to separate the parallax. Mark a third epoch.
notice.seasonWings: The marks are from opposite seasons: two are not enough to separate the parallax or the shift of the saturated wings, and the error reflects it. Mark a third epoch.
notice.scatter: The marks do not fall on a trajectory: the error was enlarged {{factor}} times. Check that every mark is on the same object.
notice.seasonal: With three or more epochs the six-month wobble (parallax and image asymmetry) is removed.

failure.outside: That point is outside the image.
failure.no-data: There is not enough data there to measure.
failure.no-source: There is no source there that stands out from the noise. Zoom in and click on the object.
failure.no-fit: The source is saturated and the wings were not enough to locate it.
failure.no-image: The epoch on screen has no image in this band.

layer.summaryPrediction: The dashed line reaches the position predicted {{years}} years later.
